label_definition: Net cashflows occurring in [install,install+horizon); refunds dated inside window subtract; no purchase occurs before prediction in this generator
feature_cutoff: observed/available/relationship-known time <= prediction; current permission and quality gate; no row dropping for graph missingness
observation: Full synthetic cashflow ledger by construction; zeros are observed zero only inside this finite synthetic universe
graph_query: Reuse identity-graph-mvp GraphFeatureService.compute/read on DEVICE; do not infer natural person; ambiguous multi-account device rejected by task-specific eligibility gate

generator.history_latent: z~Normal(0,1), independent of context and early-intent w
generator.future_cashflow_noise: independent of feature creation; same seed structure in both worlds

fitting.algorithm: standardized ridge on log1p(net revenue); back-transform with train-only residual smearing; clip predictions >=0
fitting.selection: validation MAE per horizon/model; no test tuning
fitting.preprocessing: train-only median imputation and standardization; graph unavailable encoded missing plus availability bit

counterfactuals: wrong merge guarded and explicitly unsafe diagnostic

uncertainty.report: all seeds, paired M2-M1 MAE/RMSE deltas, 95% intervals; no realistic effect interpretation
uncertainty.primary: D30 paired MAE delta M2-minus-M1 in informative and null worlds
uncertainty.multiple_comparison_policy: Other outcomes descriptive; no production significance claims
